retired.question: Every shikigami Toji Fushiguro used
retired.reason: Not declared. The Toji Fushiguro page never states that he used shikigami; every 'shikigami' mention on the page refers to Dagon's shikigami (which Toji exorcised) or to Megumi's shikigami (which he assessed). The Ten Shadows Technique is not mentioned on the Toji page, so this is not a closed, page-stated set. Left to discovery.

retired.question: Every technique or ability of Toji Fushiguro
retired.reason: Not declared as a roster. The Abilities and Powers section does enumerate his abilities (Master Weapons Specialist, Enhanced Senses, Immense Strength, Immense Speed and Reflexes, Great Tactical Intellect, Zero Cursed Energy, Physically Gifted, Revealing One's Hand), but these are prose lead-ins, not page titles, so the roster's 'members = exact page titles' contract cannot be met. Answered per-ability via the qa questions in this section instead.
